gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Aurzen's EAZZE D1 MAX has no 1/4-inch tripod thread, so it doesn't fit Aurzen's own foldable stand. Nor does any say that the USB-C-powered EAZZE D1 air runs cordless only from a power bank rated at least 65 W (20 V⎓3.25 A) with a cable rated 5 A or more.
standout_why: I compared against the cited Costco JMGO PicoPlay+ bundle listing, RTINGS best portable, What Hi-Fi best portable, TechRadar best portable, Crutchfield and our own page. Costco returned HTTP 429 and Crutchfield returned 403. RTINGS, What Hi-Fi and TechRadar returned only the page shell, with no article body. Travel + Leisure could not be fetched. So for every rival I'm going on the titles and the snippets in ChatGPT's answers. The Costco JMGO bundle has the idea of a power-bank tripod, but nothing in what ChatGPT showed gives a minimum PD wattage or cable rating. Our own page already has throw distances and says both Aurzen picks are AC-only. It says nothing on how either one mounts and has no cordless Aurzen option.
decides: There are two changes. (1) The backyard pick, the D1 MAX, cannot go on a tripod or on Aurzen's $39.99 foldable stand. Aurzen says it has no 1/4-inch thread and needs a ceiling mount using 4 M5 screws, so the page should say it is for a table or ceiling only. (2) For no-outlet use there is now an all-affiliate route in place of the Yaber. That is the Aurzen EAZZE D1 air ($199.99) with the UGREEN 145W 25,000 mAh bank. Both of the bank's USB-C ports meet Aurzen's 65 W (20 V⎓3.25 A) floor. The bank sells for $84.99 in a bundle with a 240 W cable, which is rated 5 A. Aurzen's PowerBase battery stand ($129.99) is another route. The 45 W banks in our catalog should be marked as not working. Before the D1 air goes in as the pick, we still need its lumen figure.

findings.label: Tripod / stand mounting
findings.value: No 1/4-inch threaded hole on the bottom. Mounting needs a ceiling mount with 4 M5 screws (not included).
findings.source_title: Aurzen EAZZE D1 MAX Gemini AI Google TV Projector
findings.note: Aurzen's wording, read from the aurzen.com storefront search data for this product URL with storecheck.py: 'Installation Note: Requires a ceiling mount with 4× M5 screws (not included). This projector does not feature a 1/4" threaded mounting hole on the bottom.' The product page itself returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches. The same data gave a price of $349.99 (compare-at $499.99), in stock.

findings.label: Models the maker lists as compatible
findings.value: $39.99. 1/4-inch screw mount, up to 5.5 lb (2.5 kg). Lists EAZZE D1, D1G, D1R and D1 Pro '& More'. Excludes BOOM 3. D1 MAX is not listed.
findings.note: Read from aurzen.com storefront search data. The D1 MAX's lack of a 1/4-inch thread (finding above) means this stand cannot hold it. The original D1 is listed, so the D1 + stand pairing works.

findings.label: Power bank requirement
findings.value: Power bank rated at 65 W (20 V⎓3.25 A) or more, plus a power cable rated at 5 A or more, connected through USB-C
findings.source_title: EAZZE D1 air Projector Support Center
findings.note: Aurzen's support FAQ wording: 'Use a power bank rated at 65W (20V⎓3.25A) or higher, and a power cable rated at 5A or higher.' The same page suggests a 100-inch image from about 2.83 m. Aurzen gives no runtime figure for a given power bank.

findings.label: Price and power input
findings.value: $199.99 at aurzen.com, in stock. Listed as 'USB-C PD Power for Flexible Use' with Netflix, Prime Video and YouTube built in.
findings.source_title: Aurzen EAZZE D1 air Portable Smart Projector
findings.note: From the aurzen.com storefront search data. Android Authority's 2026-03-30 launch story (https://www.androidauthority.com/aurzen-eazze-d1-air-launch-3653212/, opened 2026-11-14) says 'The D1 Air supports 65W USB-C PD input' and gives $199.99 on Amazon.

findings.label: Battery stand compatibility
findings.value: $129.99. 25,000 mAh battery plus a 1.7 ft (52 cm) stand. Made for BOOM air, D1R air and D1 air on a 1/4-inch screw. ZIP Pro needs the $35.99 Z-Stand frame. Aurzen claims 'above 2 hours of movie time'.
findings.source_title: Aurzen PowerBase Projector Stand for ZIP Pro / BOOM air / D1R air / D1 air
findings.note: Read from aurzen.com storefront search data. The listing does not include the AC-only D1 or D1 MAX. The 2-hour figure is Aurzen's claim, not a measurement.

findings.label: Per-port USB-C output against the D1 air's 65 W floor
findings.value: USB-C1: 20 V-5 A / 28 V-5 A, 140 W max. USB-C2: 20 V-3.25 A, 65 W max. Capacity 25,000 mAh / 90 Wh. $99.99 alone. $84.99 bundled with a 240 W USB-C cable.
findings.note: The tech-spec table was read from that bundle listing with storecheck.py. The plain bank is at https://us.ugreen.com/products/ugreen-145w-power-bank-for-laptop ($99.99). The 240 W cable bundle is at https://us.ugreen.com/products/145w-power-bank-240w-cable-bundle ($84.99). Both USB-C ports meet Aurzen's 20 V⎓3.25 A floor. A 240 W cable is 48 V × 5 A, so it meets the 5 A cable rule. Matches the Dealectric slug ugreen-145w-power-bank-240w-cable-bundle.

findings.label: Throw ratio and image range
findings.value: Throw ratio 1.28:1. Throw distance 3.7–18.6 ft. Image 39.8–200 in. Power input 100–240 V.
findings.source_title: Aurzen EAZZE D1 MAX Projector Specifications – ProjectorCentral
